title: One backup through AWS Backup
claim: A backup plan selects tagged resources, stores recovery points in a locked backup vault, and copies them to a vault in a second account.
alt: A production account holds an Aurora cluster, a DynamoDB table, an EFS file system and an EBS volume. A backup plan writes recovery points to a locked backup vault. A copy goes to a vault in a backup account.

edges.label: by tag
edges.say: AWS Backup can apply backup plans to your AWS resources by their tags.

edges.label: recovery points
edges.say: Each backup job saves recovery points in backup vaults, here a vault with Vault Lock.

edges.label: delete fails
edges.say: In the locked vault, a delete fails for every user, including the root user.

edges.label: copy
edges.say: A copy action puts each backup in a vault in the same or another AWS Region and in a second account.

edges.label: restore
edges.say: For most resource types, AWS Backup creates a new resource during restore.
